latest_outcome.note: QIF v0.6.43 was implemented, verified, pushed, tagged, and released. Users can now give a versioned vendor-neutral QIF package to an AI; source mappings, hashes, deterministic archive bytes, stale-content rejection, and release assets are reproducible. AI comprehension and semantic validity remain unproven.

latest_self_audit.summary: Portable package builds deterministically from canonical sources, contains 49 files, verifies source mapping and SHA-256 integrity, rejects intentional mutation, and full npm test passes 16/16 positive plus 1064/1064 negative checks.
latest_self_audit.detected_gap: Cross-vendor instruction comprehension, actual Google Drive use, evidence authenticity, and semantic verdict quality remain untested; release automation can prove asset generation but not AI compliance.
latest_self_audit.next_action: Run Council review and AOF organization verification, publish v0.6.43 with zip and checksum, then restore cross-judge correlated-error calibration as the next slice.
